- **Date Stamp:** 1987-10-12 (suggesting this is set during the "Missing Children Incident" or "Bite of '87" era)

**Interface Elements Visible:**

- **Chapter Info:** Top left shows "CAPITULO 01 - TURNO DE PRUEBA" (Chapter 01 - Test Shift) with objectives listed

**Context:** This appears to be from *Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted* or a similar FNAF-style game (note the partial animatronic figure visible on the far right edge outside the tablet frame). The black screen on the Stage camera suggests either the player needs to fix the camera, the power is out in that room, or this is a "jump scare" setup where the feed will suddenly cut to static or an animatronic face.

**The room is not visible**—you're looking at a dead monitor displaying only the HUD interface without any actual video feed of the stage or animatronics.
